summary: Toast close control needs an accessible name on every site
description:
The toast's close control is announced by screen readers as just 'Close', which does not say what it closes. closeLabel() in the shared UI library returns the text every site renders for that control. It should return 'Close notification' instead. The shared library ships the change; each site renders the toast through closeLabel() and must show the new name.

Acceptance criteria:
- closeLabel() returns exactly 'Close notification'
- Every site's toast close control is announced as 'Close notification'
- A test reproduces the defect: it fails on the current code and passes with the fix
